_comment: Read by klar-console's .claude/harness/bin/land.sh when landing this repo. Without commands.test every land was NO-GO ('THE TESTS DID NOT RUN') and each trunk push needed the operator's G12 override. The test proves every script under public/ (the only served tree) parses and every local link resolves; the build proves the deploy config (vercel.json, .vercelignore) cannot break the deploy.
